briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus push frontier capabilities while injection risks mount

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier releases this quarter. Compute scaling continues aggressively across US and Chinese labs. Regulatory focus remains fragmented amid rising security incidents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with 2.1T parameters while xAI launched Colossus-2. Anthropic and Google DeepMind are expected to counter within weeks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 800K H200 GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and CoreWeave announced new 100MW clusters in Texas and Germany.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will Chinese labs close the capability gap before 2027 or will export controls maintain a 9-month lead for Western models?
